title: Americans Who Reject the US Government | Vice Hate Thy Neighbour | True Lives
summary: Comedian's documentary visiting Montana sovereign citizens, showing their beliefs, a traffic sentencing hearing and the personal costs of the lifestyle.

assertions.quote: what they basically don't believe in the federal government. They think the rules don't apply to them.

verdicts.note: Researchers and law enforcement define the movement by its belief that current government has no legitimate authority over them.

assertions.quote: they're not ever going to stop arresting you for not [laughter] having a driver license
I've lost family. I've lost friends, lost job, lost house

verdicts.note: Case reports show frequent jail, tax liens and foreclosures, but not every adherent suffers all of these losses.
The plaintiff lost her home to foreclosure after tendering a redemption bill of exchange, and the judge warns that followers of the scheme end up in prison; this is a single case.
Cases show users losing homes (Parlee) and the author calls OPCA litigation self-destructive; jobs and family ties are not documented here.
Documented harms to users include incarceration, broken families, severe financial injury, psychiatric detention and (six Edmonton files in 2014) loss of homes.
The authors say pseudolaw causes self-inflicted harm: higher damages and costs, criminal sanctions, psychiatric detention, foreclosed homes and broken families.
